name: browser
title: Browser
concern: Real browser automation (Playwright): open a web page, read its text or links, take a screenshot, and click, type, or fill forms to carry out a task on a website.

categories.browser: Browser automation: opening a web page, reading its text or links, taking a screenshot, and clicking, typing, or filling forms to carry out a task on a website.

enabled.doc: Load this pack's skills and run its bridge. Disabled by default: it needs the optional Playwright deps + browser binaries (scripts/bootstrap.sh --browser).

token.doc: Shared secret required in the X-Semif-Token header when set.

headless.doc: false shows the browser window (to sign in once).

channel.doc: Use an already-installed browser channel (chrome/msedge) and skip Playwright's download.

executable_path.doc: Use a specific browser binary; wins over channel.

profile_dir.doc: Persistent profile directory (logins survive across calls).
